1.text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by tha will of God, according 2 tha promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,
2 Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, N peace, from God tha Father N Christ Jesus our Lord.
I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers wit pure conscience, dat without ceasing I have remembrance of u in my prayers night N day;
Greatly desiring 2 see u, bein mindful of ur tears, dat I may be filled wit joy;
When I call 2 remembrance tha unfeigned faith dat is in u, which lived first in ur grandmother Lois, N ur mother Eunice; N I am persuaded dat in u also.
So I put u in remembrance dat u stir up tha gift of God, which is in u by tha puttin on of my hands.
4 God has not given us tha spirit of fear; but of power, N of love, N of a sound mind.
Don’t be u therefore ashamed of tha testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be u partaker of tha afflictions of tha gospel according 2 tha power of God;
Who has saved us, N called us wit an holy callin, not according 2 our works, but according 2 his own purpose N grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before tha world began,
But is now made manifest by tha appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who has abolished death, N has brought life N immortality 2 light through tha gospel:
Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, N an apostle, N a teacher of tha Gentiles.
4 tha which cause I also suffer dese things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: 4 I know whom I have believed, N am persuaded dat he is able 2 keep dat which I have committed 2 him against dat day.
Hold fast tha form of sound words, which u have heard of me, in faith N love which is in Christ Jesus.
Dat good thing which was committed 2 u keep by tha Holy Ghost which lives in us.
Dis u know, dat all dey which r in Asia be turned away from me; of whom r Phygellus N Hermogenes.
Tha Lord give mercy 2 tha house of Onesiphorus; 4 he oft refreshed me, N was not ashamed of my chain:
But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, N found me.
Tha Lord grant 2 him dat he may find mercy of tha Lord in dat day: N in how many things he ministered 2 me at Ephesus, u know very well.

2.text: u therefore, my son, be strong in tha grace dat is in Christ Jesus.
N tha things dat u have heard of me among many witnesses, tha same commit u 2 faithful men, who shall be able 2 teach others also.
u therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
No man dat warreth entangleth himself wit tha affairs of dis life; dat he may please him who has chosen him 2 be a soldier.
N if a man also strive 4 masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.
Tha husbandman dat laboureth must be first partaker of tha fruits.
Consider what I say; N tha Lord give u understanding in all things.
Remember dat Jesus Christ of tha seed of David was raised from tha dead according 2 my gospel:
In which I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even 2 bonds; but tha word of God is not bound.
Therefore I endure all things 4 tha elect’s sakes, dat dey may also obtain tha salvation which is in Christ Jesus wit eternal glory.
It is a faithful sayin: 4 if we be dead wit him, we shall also live wit him:
If we suffer, we shall also reign wit him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:
If we believe not, yet he abides faithful: he cannot deny himself.
Of dese things put ’em in remembrance, charging ’em before tha Lord dat dey strive not about words 2 no profit, but 2 tha subverting of tha hearers.
Study 2 show urself approved 2 God, a workman dat needeth not 2 be ashamed, rightly dividing tha word of truth.
But shun profane N vain babblings: 4 dey will increase 2 more ungodliness.
N their word will eat as does a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus N Philetus;
Who concerning tha truth have erred, sayin dat tha resurrection is past already; N overthrow tha faith of some.
Nevertheless tha foundation of God stands sure, havin dis seal, tha Lord knows ’em dat r his. N, Let every one dat nameth tha name of Christ depart from iniquity.
But in a great house there r not only vessels of gold N of silver, but also of wood N of earth; N some 2 honour, N some 2 dishonour.
If a man therefore purge himself from dese, he shall be a vessel 2 honour, sanctified, N meet 4 tha master’s use, N prepared 2 every good work.
Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, wit ’em dat call on tha Lord out of a pure heart.
But foolish N unlearned questions avoid, knowin dat dey do gender strifes.
N tha servant of tha Lord must not strive; but be gentle 2 all men, apt 2 teach, patient,
In meekness instructing dose dat oppose themselves; if God maybe will give ’em repentance 2 tha acknowledging of tha truth;
N dat dey may recover themselves out of tha snare of tha devil, who r taken captive by him at his will.

3.text: Dis know also, dat in tha last days perilous times shall come.
4 men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient 2 parents, unthankful, unholy,
Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of dose dat r good,
Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;
Havin a form of godliness, but denying tha power of it: from such turn away.
4 of dis sort r dey which creep in2 houses, N lead captive silly women laden wit sins, led away wit divers lusts,
Ever learning, N never able 2 come 2 tha knowledge of tha truth.
Now as Jannes N Jambres withstood Moses, so do dese also resist tha truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning tha faith.
But dey shall proceed no further: 4 their folly shall be manifest 2 all men, as theirs also was.
But u have fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,
Persecutions, afflictions, which came 2 me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of ’em all tha Lord delivered me.
Yeah, N all dat will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.
But evil men N seducers shall wax worse N worse, deceiving, N bein deceived.
But continue u in tha things which u have learned N have been assured of, knowin of whom u have learned ’em;
N dat from a child u have known tha holy scriptures, which r able 2 make u wise 2 salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
All scripture is given by inspiration of God, N is profitable 4 doctrine, 4 reproof, 4 correction, 4 instruction in righteousness:
Dat tha man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished 2 all good works.

4.text: I charge u therefore before God, N tha Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge tha quick N tha dead at his appearing N his kingdom;
Preach tha word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort wit all longsuffering N doctrine.
4 tha time will come when dey will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall dey heap 2 themselves teachers, havin itching ears;
N dey shall turn away their ears from tha truth, N shall be turned 2 fables.
But watch u in all things, endure afflictions, do tha work of an evangelist, make full proof of ur ministry.
4 I am now ready 2 be offered, N tha time of my departure is at hand.
I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept tha faith:
From now on there is laid up 4 me a crown of righteousness, which tha Lord, tha righteous judge, shall give me at dat day: N not 2 me only, but 2 all ’em also dat love his appearing.
Do ur diligence 2 come shortly 2 me:
4 Demas has forsaken me, havin loved dis present world, N is departed 2 Thessalonica; Crescens 2 Galatia, Titus 2 Dalmatia.
Only Luke is wit me. Take Mark, N bring him wit u: 4 he is profitable 2 me 4 tha ministry.
N Tychicus have I sent 2 Ephesus.
Tha cloke dat I left at Troas wit Carpus, when u come, bring wit u, N tha books, but especially tha parchments.
Alexander tha coppersmith did me much evil: tha Lord reward him according 2 his works:
Of whom be u ware also; 4 he has greatly withstood our words.
At my first answer no man stood wit me, but all men forsook me: I pray God dat it may not be laid 2 their charge.
Even so tha Lord stood wit me, N strengthened me; dat by me tha preachin might be fully known, N dat all tha Gentiles might hear: N I was delivered out of tha mouth of tha lion.
N tha Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, N will preserve me 2 his heavenly kingdom: 2 whom be glory 4 ever N ever. Amen.
Greet Prisca N Aquila, N tha household of Onesiphorus.
Erastus stayed at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.
Do ur diligence 2 come before winter. Eubulus greeteth u, N Pudens, N Linus, N Claudia, N all tha brothers.
Tha Lord Jesus Christ be wit ur spirit. Grace be wit u. Amen.
